cohort: 317 women who gave birth at Al Zahra'a Hospital for Maternity & Paediatric in Najaf, Iraq in 2020
finding: Mothers and newborns experienced lower risk of severe complications shortly after delivery with breech presentation compared to cephalic presentation.
mod_finding: Traumatic birth injuries were more prevalent in the cephalic presentation vaginal delivery group compared to the breech presentation vaginal delivery group (62.7% vs 0%).
